sentences.text:
2023 
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No. Of 2023

(arising out of SLP(Crl.) NO. 9461 of 2022)
 VISHRUT SHUKLA   VERSUS  STATE OF CHHATTISGARH & ANR. 
 O R D E R Leave granted.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties.
Parties are in a matrimonial dispute, wherein various allegations and counter allegations have been made.

The impugned judgment dated 04.08.2022,
while denying bail to the appellant  Vishrut Shukla, grants bail to his aged parents, and his sister who is a resident of Ireland.
Vide interim order dated 17.10.2022 passed by this Court, the arrest of the appellant  Vishrut Shukla was stayed subject to his joining and cooperating in the investigation.
The appellant - Vishrut Shukla has joined the investigation and cooperated.
The appellant and the 2nd respondent are well-educated and working.
Chargesheet is yet to be filed.
Proceedings inter se parties are pending.

In light of the facts and circumstances of the present case, we set aside the impugned judgment dated 04.08.2022 and allow the present appeal with a direction that in the event of the appellant - Vishrut Shukla being arrested in connection with Crime/First Information Report (FIR) no.
112/2022 dated 07.06.2022 registered 13:43:18 IST Reason:
at Police Station  Mahila Thana, District  Raipur, Chhattisgarh for the offence(s)
punishable under Section 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860,
he shall be released on bail by the arresting officer/investigating officer/trial Court on terms and conditions to be fixed by the trial Court.
In addition, the appellant - Vishrut Shukla will comply with the requirements of Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

At this stage, learned counsel appearing for the appellant - Vishrut Shukla states that without prejudice to the rights and contentions of the appellant, he shall pay Rs.40,000/- (Rupees forty thousand only) per month to respondent no. 2/complainant towards maintenance for the child, with effect from October 2023.
